T: Dinosaurs on show. Dinner on the table.
D: A fully working dinosaur theme park opens on Isla Nublar, and its newest creation escapes.
P: Serve the snacks when the mosasaur leaps up to grab its lunch.
S: Garlic chilli lime butter prawns grilled and piled on a platter
Big prawns grilled with garlic, chilli and lime, piled high on a platter with lime wedges for the crowd.
Cream cheese and cheddar balls rolled in chopped walnuts and smoked paprika
Cheddar, cream cheese and chives rolled into balls, coated in crushed nuts and paprika, with crackers.
knots baked chewy, buttered and rolled in sweet spice, caramel dip

Soft pretzels dipped in a bicarb bath, baked chewy and brown, brushed with butter and rolled in cinnamon sugar, with warm caramel dip. Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Shape into 8 pretzels. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each pretzel for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Brush with 60g melted butter and toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Serve with warmed caramel sauce.
M: paprika and pepper rubbed, slow cooked off the bone, sticky glaze, corn

Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and pepper, slow cooked until they pull off the bone, glazed sticky, with buttered corn and slaw. Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt. Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140C for 5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar.
Chilli cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbage
White fish dusted in chilli and cumin, pan-fried, in corn tortillas with cabbage, pineapple salsa and lime crema.
W: Dark chocolate mousse in glasses, biscuit soil, speckled choc egg on top
Chocolate mousse set in glasses, topped with crushed chocolate biscuit soil and a speckled chocolate egg.
K: Fresh lemonade blended with ice till slushy, in big souvenir cups
Lemon juice, sugar and water frozen and blitzed into slush, poured into big cups with straws.

Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 hour, grill fresh

ingredients.item: king brown mushrooms, cut into thick coins
limes, one zested and the rest in wedges

steps.text: Toss the mushrooms with the garlic, red chillies, lime zest, melted butter and salt.
Grill for 3 minutes a side until charred.
Pile high on a platter with lime wedges.
Mix the cheddar, cream cheese and chives. Roll into small balls.
Coat in the walnuts mixed with the paprika.
Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the dough up to a day ahead and keep it in the fridge, bake fresh

ingredients.item: caster sugar (1 tbsp for the dough)

steps.text: Mix the flour, yeast, salt, 1 tbsp sugar and warm water into a dough and knead for 8 minutes.
Cover and rest for 1 hour until puffy.
Heat the oven to 220C. Roll the dough into 8 ropes and twist each into a pretzel knot.
Boil 2L water with the bicarb soda and dip each knot for 30 seconds, then lift onto a lined tray.
Bake for 12 minutes until deep brown.
Brush with the melted butter, toss in the rest of the sugar mixed with the cinnamon and serve with warm caramel sauce.

dishes.make_ahead: Slow cook a day ahead, chill in the foil, glaze and roast to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 140C. Rub the short ribs all over with the smoked paprika, pepper, brown sugar and salt.
Wrap tightly in foil and cook for 5 hours until the meat pulls off the bone.
Turn the oven up to 220C, unwrap, brush with the barbecue sauce and roast for 15 minutes until sticky.
Boil the corn for 6 minutes and butter it.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and vinegar for slaw and serve with the ribs and corn.

dishes.make_ahead: Salsa up to 2 hours ahead, fish fresh

steps.text: Dice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.
Dust the flathead fillets in the chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry in the oil until just cooked. Flake into pieces.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

veg.make_ahead: Salsa up to 2 hours ahead, haloumi fresh

steps.text: Dice the pineapple and onion and mix with lime juice for the salsa. Mix the sour cream with lime for the crema.
Dust the haloumi in the chilli and cumin and pan-fry in the oil until golden on both sides. Cut into strips.
Warm the tortillas and shred the cabbage.
Fill the tortillas with cabbage, haloumi, salsa and crema.

dishes.make_ahead: Make a day ahead, keep chilled. The eggs stay raw, so use very fresh ones and skip for pregnant guests

steps.text: Melt the chocolate and cool slightly.
Whip the cream and whisk the egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in the cream and whites.
Spoon into glasses and chill for 2 hours.
Top with crushed biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg.

dishes.make_ahead: Freeze a day ahead, blitz fresh

steps.text: Dissolve the sugar in the lemon juice and water.
Freeze in a tray for 2 hours.
Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws.

s.note: Garlic chilli lime butter prawns grilled and piled on a platter
s.how: Toss 600g green prawns with crushed garlic, chopped red chilli, lime zest and melted butter. Grill for 2 minutes a side until charred. Pile high on a platter with lime wedges, ready for the crowd at feeding time.

s.note: Cream cheese and cheddar balls rolled in chopped walnuts and smoked paprika
s.how: Mix 200g grated cheddar, 250g cream cheese and snipped chives. Roll into small balls and coat in finely chopped walnuts mixed with smoked paprika. Chill for an hour until firm. Serve with water crackers and stay inside the sphere.

s.note: Knots baked chewy, buttered and rolled in sweet spice, caramel dip
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp salt, 1 tbsp sugar and 320ml warm water into a dough, knead 8 minutes and rest 1 hour. Shape into 8 pretzel knots. Boil 2L water with 4 tbsp bicarb soda and dip each knot for 30 seconds. Bake at 220C for 12 minutes until brown. Brush with 60g melted butter, toss in 100g sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon and serve with warm caramel sauce.

m.note: Paprika and pepper rubbed, slow cooked off the bone, sticky glaze, corn
m.how: Rub 2kg beef short ribs with 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp cracked pepper, 1 tbsp brown sugar and 2 tsp salt. Wrap tightly in foil and cook at 140C for 5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 200ml barbecue sauce and roast at 220C for 15 minutes until sticky. Boil 4 corn cobs for 6 minutes and butter them. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 1 grated carrot with 4 tbsp mayo and 1 tbsp vinegar for slaw.

m.note: Chilli cumin flathead tacos with pineapple salsa, lime crema and cabbage
m.how: Dust 600g flathead in chilli, cumin and salt and pan-fry until just cooked. Dice half a pineapple with a little red onion and lime for salsa. Mix sour cream with lime for a crema. Fill corn tortillas with cabbage, fish, salsa and crema.

w.note: Dark chocolate mousse in glasses, biscuit soil, speckled choc egg on top
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate and cool slightly. Whip 300ml cream and whisk 3 egg whites to soft peaks. Stir the yolks into the chocolate, then fold in cream and whites. Spoon into glasses, chill, top with crushed chocolate biscuits and a speckled chocolate egg. The eggs stay raw, so use very fresh ones and skip for pregnant guests.

d.note: Fresh lemonade blended with ice till slushy, in big souvenir cups
d.how: Squeeze 6 lemons and dissolve 150g sugar in the juice with 500ml water. Freeze in a tray for 2 hours. Blitz with a few handfuls of ice until slushy and pour into big cups with straws. Perfect for a long queue in the heat.
